name: Bamidele Oni, MSc, Dip.OHS, Dip.THSc, EPt
bio: As the founder and CEO of SAFEinEA Incorporated, Bamidele brings a wealth of knowledge and hands-on experience in occupational health and safety across multiple industries.

With advanced degrees and certifications, including a Master of Science degree and diploma in occupational health and safety, Bamidele is committed to advancing workplace safety standards across Canada. As an Auditor, he holds Auditors certificates for MASH Audit, SAFEWORK Certification Audit and COR Certification Audit.
